description: Canonical leaderboard period keys for a UTC instant at noon on each date. Three independent derivations must agree on every case: LeaderboardTimeFrame.currentPeriod (client), previousPeriod in functions/src/leaderboardAchievements.ts (finalizer), and currentPeriod in scripts/lib/leaderboard-period.mjs (the one seeding derivation - seed-demo-user.mjs and seed/fixtures/profile-fixtures.mjs both import it). A document written under one spelling is invisible to a reader using another, and the board just looks empty.
